intro.text: The sword the Prophet left in the Megalith's heart when he defeated it, said to answer only to his will and words.

The Prophet's weapon that splinters the Megalith and binds it to its corpse in Kingseat, so it cannot re-form or leave that shell. His religion's symbols show a sword, but it is really a spike ten feet long.

description.text: The king is thought able to draw it, because he knows its secret passphrases.
The first passphrase moves the Breaths held in the sword into a vessel, and the second moves them back out.
A third passphrase scatters the Breaths altogether, letting them go back to the Spiritual Realm.

It is a silver spike with an Aon fixed to it by purified Breaths. It holds back a fragment of the Megalith's essence and breaks the rest into smaller demons. The passphrases, which the Prophet told the royal line directly, alter its unkeyed Breaths and destroy the Aon that binds the Megalith.
The passphrases were also passed down through the Prophet's Mandata.

items.text: With a dragon's help, the Prophet drove it into the Megalith's heart with a giant crossbow, having waited more than three days for the right moment.
He had made it by Awakening: a padding of transformed Breath fixed Aon Reo to the silver spike, and he set three passphrases to change it in case the seals ever began to break.
Lord Geoffrim pressed the king to speak the passphrases and release the Megalith.
Hoid examined the sword with December and found that what bound the Megalith was weakening, but not enough to call for releasing it.
